item.title: High Speed Rail Isn't Just Fast Trains, There Are Rigidly Defined Categories
item.dc:creator: Rohan Kapoor
item.description: The uninformed often fall for the illusion that high-speed rail is simply a railroad operating extremely fast trains. In actuality, it's an entire transportation system tightly regulated by government agencies. The Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) attempted to spur high-speed rail development in 2018 by letting operators run high-speed trains on existing speed-limited infrastructure, but so far, no new service has usurped Amtrak's Acela on the Northeast Corridor as America's fastest train.

item.title: Tata Car Sales 2026 Overtakes 2025 Total With 2 Months To Spare
item.dc:creator: Kabir Sharma
item.description: Tata Motors surpassed its entire 2025 passenger vehicle sales tally with two months to spare. Domestic wholesales reached 6,49,477 units in the first 10 months of 2026, already 70,705 units, or 12.22%, above the 5,78,772 units sold across all of 2025. Against the comparable January–October 2025 period, when Tata sold 4,71,290 units, volumes increased by 1,78,187 units. Tata had sold 5,75,583 units by the end of September 2026, leaving it just 3,189 units short of its full-year 2025 tally.
